in_sanskrit.name: ध्रुवथा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is fixed, steady, firm, unwavering, unchanging.

in_hindi.name: ध्रुवथा
in_hindi.long_meaning: स्थिर, निश्चल होने वाला, अचल होने वाला

in_marathi.name: Dhruvatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of Dhruva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhruvatha is the name of a star that symbolizes unwavering faith and determination.

in_bengali.name: Dhruvatha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Star of Dhruva
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhruvatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Dhruvatha is the name of a star that symbolizes unwavering faith and determination.
